copy.title: Trulock Locksmiths | Official Site — Fixed Prices, Local Branches
copy.description: Trulock Locksmiths: the straight-answers locksmith network. Eight branches from Woking and Worthing to Brighouse and Rawtenstall, all working to one public promise — the price you're quoted is the price you pay.
copy.topbar: The price we quote is the price you pay — that's the whole brand
copy.h1: The quote is the bill. Every time.
copy.lead: Locksmithing has a trust problem — mystery call-out fees, prices that double at the door, 'from £49' that never ends at £49. Trulock's eight branches, from the Surrey commuter belt to the Pennine valleys, were built as the answer: a full fixed quote before work starts, and a bill that matches it.
copy.heroNote: {n} branches. One pricing promise, publicly stated, honoured on every job.

coverage.heading: Find your Trulock branch
coverage.intro: Eight local branches, each answering its own phone on its own number. The areas listed are that branch's regular rounds — pick your town for its full site.
coverage.areaPattern: Fixed prices honoured in {areas} and everywhere in {town}

services.heading: Every job, priced the same way
services.intro: Whatever the job, the sequence is identical: look, quote, agree, work. Nothing starts until you've said yes to a number.
featured: One fixed price for entry, agreed on the phone — not renegotiated on your doorstep at midnight.
Quoted per door with hardware named and priced, so you can compare us before we arrive.
24/7 response with the same price list as 2pm on a Tuesday. Emergencies aren't a surcharge opportunity.
If it's repairable we quote the repair — we don't quote a replacement and hope you won't ask.
Make-safe and reinstatement itemised clearly, ready to hand straight to your insurer.
Insurance-standard locks with the standard named on the quote, the invoice and the guarantee.

why.heading: What 'Tru' costs us — and earns you
why.intro: A fixed-price promise only works if the whole network keeps it. Here's how we hold the line.
points: The engineer quotes the full job — labour, parts, VAT — before touching your door. You can say no, and sometimes people do. That's the point.
No small print on the clock
Nights, weekends and bank holidays cost what weekdays cost. A lockout at 3am is stressful enough without a premium.
Every invoice names the hardware fitted and the guarantee on it — useful for insurers, landlords and your own records.
One branch breaking the promise damages eight. Branches audit each other's quotes, which keeps everyone honest.

cta.heading: Get a number before you commit
cta.sub: Call your local Trulock branch, describe the job, and get the fixed price — then decide.

copy.footerBlurb: The official site of Trulock Locksmiths — eight branches across England working to one public promise: the price quoted is the price paid.
